newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble little changed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Rouble little changed in quiet trade.

text.p: The rouble was little changed in calm trading on Tuesday and there is no clear trend in the thin market, dealers said.
"Rates are stable and it is impossible to say definitely whether it is because of (Wednesday's Treasury bill) auctions or client orders," one dealer said.
On Wednesday the central bank is auctioning 8.5 trillion roubles of six-month paper and 1.5 trillion roubles in a new tranche of three-month bills.

"There is no fuss, the day is very calm. There are roubles on the market but they are expensive so it could be profitable to invest free funds in short-term deposits," Neftekhimbank dealer Vladimir Zrazhevsky said.

Roubles for today settlement were quoted at 5,407-10 per dollar compared with an early 5,405-08 and 5,402-05 late on Monday. Tomorrow roubles edged down to 5,413-16 per dollar from yesterday's late 5,407-09.
The central bank said it had set 5,406/5,418 as its bid and offer rates against the dollar on Tuesday.
Overnight rouble credits yielded 40-60 percent, the same as late on Monday.
